_om: Tallknuseren in English (Number Cruncher, rusj.no/en/number-cruncher/): sudoku, with «Today's sudoku». Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Litt mer å tenke på: A bit more to think about
Visk ut tallet først for å skrive notate: Erase the number first to write notes
The board is full, but something's not right. Look for the numbers marked with an exclamation mark.
Tallene fra start kan ikke viskes ut: The starting numbers can't be erased
Tall fra hint kan ikke viskes ut: Numbers from hints can't be erased
I denne boksen er det bare én plass til: There's only one place for {d} in this box.
I denne raden er det bare én plass til {: There's only one place for {d} in this row.
I denne kolonnen er det bare én plass ti: There's only one place for {d} in this column.
Bare {d} passer her. Alle andre tall stå: Only {d} fits here. Every other number is already in the row, column or box.
One number was wrong. It's been erased.
{n} numbers were wrong. They've been erased.
Fyll brettet med tall fra 1 til 9. Hvert: Fill the board with the numbers 1 to 9. Each number must appear exactly once in every row, every column and every 3 × 3 box.
Trykk på en tom rute, og trykk på tallet: Tap an empty square, then tap the number that goes there.
Samme tall kan ikke stå to ganger i en r: The same number can't appear twice in a row, a column or a box. If it does, both turn red and get an exclamation mark.
Usikker? Slå på Notater og skriv små tal: Not sure? Switch on Notes and pencil in small numbers. They tidy themselves away when you place a number.
Ta ett tall om gangen: Hvor kan 1-tallet: Take one number at a time: where can the 1 go in each box? Often there's only one place.
De små tallene på tastene viser hvor man: The small numbers on the keys show how many of each number are still missing. ✓ means all nine are placed.
Står du fast? Du har tre hint per brett,: Stuck? You get three hints per board, and each hint tells you why the number goes there.
Dagens sudoku er den samme for alle i he: Today's sudoku is the same for everyone: easy on Monday, expert on Sunday.
Dagens sudoku og et vanlig brett kan vær: Today's sudoku and an ordinary board can be on the go at the same time – neither disappears when you open the other.
Med tastatur: piltaster, tallene 1–9, Ba: On a keyboard: arrow keys, the numbers 1–9, Backspace, N for notes and P to pause.
Hvert brett er nytt og har bare én løsni: Every board is new and has only one solution.
The board is waiting for you.
Du løste dagens sudoku på {tid} første g: You solved today's sudoku in {tid} the first time.
Ny personlig rekord på {niva}! Forrige:: A new personal best on {niva}! Previous: {tid}.
Første brett på {niva} – nå har du en re: Your first board on {niva} – now you've got a time to beat!
